Im coming to dig your grave!|Beginning of Wave 30 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Final Wave Test|Beginning of Wave 40 ([[Easy Mode|Beginner's]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Grave Digger''' was the first major boss in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and the original final boss of [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, though it was replaced by a new version which was later moved to [[Casual Mode|Casual]], with this enemy being a legacy enemy. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. The '''Grave Digger''' has [[Stun Immunity]], reducing the effectiveness of the stun from stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]], while also preventing it from being knocked back. As it is a boss enemy, it is also immune to being frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], confused by the [[Jester]], damaged from the [[Nuke]]'s fallout and slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]]. It has very high health compared to anything that spawns before, but to compensate, it moves very slowly. In addition, it can stun towers and damage units by performing its ''Stomp'' abilities. It can also perform its ''Triumphing Sheol'' ability which "unearths" multiple [[enemies]]. The '''Grave Digger''' was replaced by the [[Toilet Boss]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Grave Digger''' is a large boss, larger than most enemies. It has green skin, and bandages are wrapped around its legs and arms. It wears a tattered black jacket and metal-plated boots. It wears two orange belts and has marble grey legs. It has a brown shovel to dig up enemies. It has a chain wrapped around its torso and there is a [[Tombstone]] on its back. It has a twisted left leg. When first added, it had a normal walking animation while carrying its shovel with its right arm. It wore a hood, had glowing red eyes, and had a neutral face. |Version 1 |The original '''Grave Digger''' is like the current version, except it had a mouth. When first added, it had a normal walking animation while carrying its shovel with its right arm. It wore a hood, had glowing red eyes, and had a neutral face. }} ==Enemies Spawned== By default, it will only generate [[Normal]]s in modes without a set spawn pool.

MegaGraveDiggerFace.png| First version of Grave Digger Face (13 October 2019 - 8 May 2021) }} ==Trivia== *This [[Enemies|enemy]] replaced the [[Gravekeeper]]. *There is a Roblox bundle based on the '''Grave Digger''', namely the [https://www.roblox.com/bundles/996/Grave-Digger Grave Digger] bundle. **Weirdly, the bundle used to call the '''Grave Digger''' a goblin in its name, despite it not being a goblin in-game. **The individual items of the bundle, such as the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/11768976933/Grave-Digger-Goblin-Torso Grave Digger Goblin - Torso], still call it a goblin. *The '''Grave Digger's''' second final wave music is a remixed version of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vwvwXt5cnS4 Cursed Abbey]. **Coincidentally, the [[Raider Boss]] also used the same song, just not remixed. *When the '''Grave Digger''' was first added, the icon of the [[Gravekeeper]] was still used, even though it was removed. *Prior to the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]], the '''Grave Digger''' could stun the [[Mortar]] using its ''Stomp'' ability due to a bug. This was the only major boss that could stun cliff towers with a stomp ability. *The [[Logbooks|Logbook]] it drops only unlocks the entry for the [[Grave Digger|modern version]] but not the legacy '''Grave Digger'''. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''13 October 2019''' -
